definitions.explanation: A piece of paper stuck or posted on a wall, door, or other surface to convey a message. Common in everyday Japanese life for announcements, warnings, and notices.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{張|は}り{紙|がみ}がして⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a notice posted on the door.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}→立入禁止：09542_tachiirikinshi⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{張|は}り{紙|がみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a 'No Entry' sign posted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{管理人|かんりにん}→管理人：03047_kanrinin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{修理中|しゅうりちゅう}→修理中：20768_shuurichuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{張|は}り{紙|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: The building manager put up an 'under repair' notice on the elevator.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common everyday word in Japan, where handwritten or printed notices are frequently posted in apartment buildings, stores, and public spaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {張|は}り{紙|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to post a notice)
- {張|は}り{紙|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put up a notice)
- {張|は}り{紙|がみ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no posting allowed)

FORMS:
{張|は}り (pasting, sticking) + ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ (paper). The ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ becomes ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ due to rendaku (sequential voicing).
